'''2020 TMW Pods Justin Carulli LS They Have No Idea We're Coming''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Justin Carulli]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Justin Carulli]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods

* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open They Have No Idea We're Comi Carull.txt |Download]]
